out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed handwashing sink at the back kitchen is not in working condition.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC placed a work order for handwashing sink repair.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HANDWASHING SINK (BACK KITCHEN) piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC PLACED A WORK ORDER FOR LEAKING SINK AND WILL ENSURE PLUMBING IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
